short_description.id: Tengri adalah sebutan dewa utama dalam tradisi Turk dan Mongol awal.
short_description.en: Tengri names a principal deity in early Turkic and Mongol traditions.

long_description.id: Tengri adalah sebutan dewa utama dalam tradisi Turk dan Mongol awal. Konsep Tengri mencakup langit biru yang jernih dan peran dewa nasib. Dalam mitos penciptaan Mongol, Tengri Khairkhan muncul sebagai pencipta bumi.
long_description.en: Tengri names a principal deity in early Turkic and Mongol traditions. The Tengri concept includes the clear blue sky and a deity of fate. In Mongol creation mythology, Tengri Khairkhan appears as the creator of the earth.

long_description.id: Han shu mencatat bahwa orang Xiongnu menyebut langit 撐犁 dan menamai pemimpin mereka 撐犁孤塗單于. Sebuah artikel rujukan menyebut bentuk tertua nama itu dalam arsip Tiongkok sebagai 撑犁 dan menduganya transkripsi dari Tängri, serta menyatakan bahwa kata tengri umumnya diasumsikan semula berarti "langit".
long_description.en: The Han shu records that the Xiongnu call heaven 撐犁 and named their ruler 撐犁孤塗單于. A reference article gives the oldest form of the name in Chinese annals as 撑犁 and hypothesizes that it transcribes Tängri, and it states that the word tengri is generally assumed to have originally meant "sky".

long_description.id: Menurut artikel yang sama, Tengri adalah dewa nasional bangsa Göktürk dan para khan mereka mendasarkan kekuasaan pada mandat dari Tengri. Prasasti untuk Kul Tigin, dalam terjemahan yang dikutip, menyebut bahwa langit biru di atas dan bumi cokelat di bawah diciptakan, dan di antara keduanya manusia diciptakan. Dalam prasasti Orkhon, Bilge Kagan menyebut dirinya sebagai Turk yang seperti Tengri dan lahir dari Tengri.
long_description.en: According to the same article, Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks and their khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri. The inscription for Kul Tigin, in the translation quoted, says that the blue sky above and the brown earth below were created, and between them a human being was created. In the Orkhon inscriptions, Bilge Kaghan calls himself Tengri-like and Tengri-born.

short_description.id: Sekhmet adalah dewi prajurit dan penyembuhan dalam mitologi Mesir.
short_description.en: Sekhmet is an Egyptian warrior and healing goddess.

long_description.id: Sekhmet adalah dewi prajurit dan penyembuhan dalam mitologi Mesir. Sekhmet juga merupakan dewi matahari dengan gelar Mata Ra. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan Hathor dan Bastet.
long_description.en: Sekhmet is an Egyptian warrior and healing goddess. Sekhmet is also a solar deity with the epithet Eye of Ra. She is often associated with Hathor and Bastet.

long_description.id: Sekhmet adalah manifestasi pembalasan Ra yang disebut Mata Ra. Ia dianggap menyebabkan wabah, sekaligus dimohon untuk menyembuhkan. Ra mengirim Hathor dalam bentuk Sekhmet menghukum manusia yang bersekongkol. Para dewa menghentikannya dengan bir merah yang disangka darah. Versi lain mengisahkan Thoth membujuk Sekhmet kembali setelah ia meninggalkan Mesir.
long_description.en: Sekhmet is a vengeful manifestation of Ra called the Eye of Ra. She is believed to cause plagues and is also invoked for healing. Ra sends Hathor as Sekhmet to punish conspiring mortals. The gods stop her with red beer mistaken for blood. Another version tells of Thoth persuading Sekhmet to return after she leaves Egypt.

long_description.id: Ia adalah istri Ptah dan ibu Nefertum. Festival mabuk mengulang minum yang meredakan amarahnya dalam mitos. Namanya diartikan Yang Perkasa. Ia menjadi pelindung militer melalui kekuatan penghancuran dan pembalasan. Salah satu gelarnya adalah Penghantam Orang Nubia. Gelar Nyonya Kehidupan berkaitan dengan kemampuannya menyembuhkan wabah. Budge memakai nama Sekhet untuk pasangan feminin Ptah dalam triad bersama Nefertem.
long_description.en: She is Ptah’s wife and Nefertum’s mother. A festival of intoxication reenacts the drinking that calms her mythical wrath. Her name is interpreted as the Powerful One. She becomes a military patron through destruction and vengeance. One of her titles is Smiter of the Nubians. The Mistress of Life title relates to her ability to cure plague. Budge uses Sekhet for Ptah’s feminine counterpart in a triad with Nefertem.

short_description.id: Ahura Mazda adalah ilahi tertinggi dalam Zoroastrianism, dipandang sebagai pencipta yang bijak dan pemelihara tatanan kebenaran.
short_description.en: Ahura Mazda is the supreme divinity of Zoroastrianism, regarded as a wise creator and sustainer of truth and order.

long_description.id: Ahura Mazda berasal dari agama Old Iranian dan ditempatkan oleh Zoroaster sebagai God. Penafsiran nama Mazdā sebagai 'kebijaksanaan' atau 'bijak' masih diperdebatkan; Ahura berarti tuan. Tradisi Zoroastrianism menghubungkannya dengan aša, tatanan dan kebenaran kosmis, serta keadilan.
long_description.en: Ahura Mazda comes from ancient Iranian religion and was elevated by Zoroaster as God. Scholars debate whether Mazdā means 'wisdom' or 'wise', while Ahura means lord. Sources on Zoroastrianism link him to aša, cosmic truth and order, and to justice.

long_description.id: Dalam uraian Zoroaster yang dibahas Kajian ini, Ahura Mazda tidak diciptakan dan memunculkan enam wujud agung. Manusia diberi pilihan moral; kejahatan berasal dari sumber selain Ahura Mazda. Uraian akademik itu juga mengingatkan bahwa gagasan Zoroaster tentang kuasanya tidak sama dengan konsep kemahakuasaan yang berkembang kemudian.
long_description.en: In the account of Zoroaster discussed by an academic source, Ahura Mazda is uncreated and emanates six great beings. Humans have moral choice, while evil has a source other than Ahura Mazda. Zoroaster did not conceive of Ahura Mazda as omnipotent.

long_description.id: Prasasti Darius menyebut Ahuramazda sebagai pencipta bumi, langit, manusia, dan kebahagiaan, serta sumber legitimasi kerajaan dan perlindungan. Bentuk nama Ahuramazda, Hormazd, dan Ohrmazd berubah menurut periode. Kajian ini menyatakan belum ada penggambaran Ahuramazda yang tercatat dari masa Achaemenid awal.
long_description.en: Darius's inscription calls Ahuramazda creator of earth, sky, people, and happiness, as well as the source of royal legitimacy and protection. The forms Ahuramazda, Hormazd, and Ohrmazd vary by period. An academic source says no depiction of Ahuramazda is recorded for the early Achaemenid period.

long_description.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead. She is a daughter of Nut and Geb. Isis is her sister and partner in funerary rites.

long_description.id: Ia disebut saudari sekaligus istri Set. Ia dikaitkan dengan perkabungan, malam, dan perlindungan. Namanya lazim diterjemahkan sebagai Nyonya Rumah atau Nyonya Kuil. Bersama Isis ia melambangkan gerbang pylon kuil. Ia dipandang sebagai dewi pelindung yang melambangkan pengalaman kematian.
long_description.en: She is described as Set’s sister and wife. She is associated with mourning, night and protection. Her name is usually translated as Lady of the House or Lady of the Temple. With Isis she symbolizes a temple’s pylon gateway. She is viewed as a protective goddess symbolizing the death experience.

long_description.id: Sebagian mitos menjadikannya ibu Anubis; kisah lain memberi Anubis ibu berbeda. Ia juga berperan sebagai pengasuh firaun. Ia dikenal sebagai Sahabat Orang Mati. Peratap profesional disebut Layang-Layang Nephthys. Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys dipakai dalam festival, ibadah, dan pemakaman. Dalam teks tersebut ia memanggil jiwa Osiris kembali dari kematian. Budge menyebut tempat Nephthys dalam bahtera matahari saat penciptaan dan kaitannya dengan senja.
long_description.en: Some myths make her Anubis’s mother; others give him a different mother. She also acts as a nurse to the pharaoh. She is known as Friend of the Dead. Professional mourners are called the Kites of Nephthys. The Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys is used at festivals, services and funerals. In that text she calls Osiris’s soul back from death. Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.

short_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan, istri Odin dan ibu Baldr, yang dikenal berkaitan dengan pernikahan serta ramalan.
short_description.en: Frigg is a Norse fertility goddess, Odin's wife and Baldr's mother, associated with marriage and prophecy.

long_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan dan istri Odin. Ia dihubungkan dengan pernikahan, keibuan, kecerdikan dan ramalan; Baldr dan Hodr disebut sebagai putranya. Nama Friday berkaitan dengan namanya. Beberapa nama lainnya adalah Frigga, Frea, dan Fria.
long_description.en: Frigg is a fertility goddess and Odin's wife. She is linked to marriage, motherhood, cleverness and prophecy; Baldr and Hodr are named as her sons. English Friday is named for her. Other names include Frigga, Frea and Fria.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah kematian Baldr, Frigg meminta segala sesuatu berjanji tidak melukainya, tetapi melewatkan mistletoe. Loki memanfaatkan kelalaian itu sehingga Hodr melempar tumbuhan tersebut dan Baldr tewas. Frigg juga dikisahkan tinggal di Fensalir, yang letaknya tidak dijelaskan.
long_description.en: In the death of Baldr, Frigg asks all things to promise not to hurt him but overlooks mistletoe. Loki exploits this omission; Hodr throws the plant and Baldr dies. Frigg is also said to dwell in Fensalir, whose location is unspecified.

long_description.id: Sebuah tradisi Lombards menyebutnya Freia, istri Odin yang membantu kemenangan mereka. Hubungan asal-usulnya dengan Freyja tetap diperdebatkan; sebuah ensiklopedia lama bahkan mengingatkan agar keduanya tidak diidentifikasi begitu saja. Sumber modern menegaskan Frigg bukan ibu Thor.
long_description.en: A tradition of the Lombards calls her Freia, Odin's wife who helps the Lombards win. Her possible historical connection to Freyja remains speculative, and an older encyclopedia warns against identifying the two outright. A modern source says she is not Thor's mother.

short_description.en: Inari is a kami associated with rice, grain, and prosperity in Japan.

long_description.id: Dalam istilah Shinto, Inari disebut pelindung budidaya padi dan lima jenis biji-bijian. Kitab Shinto juga menyebutnya Uka-no-mitama-no-kami. Kuil Fushimi Inari Taisha menjelaskan bahwa lima tempat pemujaan utamanya mewakili berbagai keutamaan Inari Okami.
long_description.en: In Shinto terminology, Inari is a tutelary deity of rice cultivation and five grains. Shinto classics also call Inari Uka-no-mitama-no-kami. Fushimi Inari Taisha explains that five main enshrined deities embody different virtues of Inari Okami.

long_description.id: Tradisi Inari juga berhubungan dengan rubah. Pemuja Inari di berbagai daerah mengaitkannya dengan kesejahteraan perdagangan dan kebutuhan setempat. Kuil Fushimi Inari menjelaskan nama Inari sebagai bentuk pendek ungkapan lama yang berkaitan dengan panen padi.
long_description.en: Inari tradition is also associated with foxes. Worshipers in different regions connect Inari with commercial prosperity and local concerns. Fushimi Inari Shrine explains the name Inari as a shortened older expression relating to rice harvests.

short_description.id: Mnemosyne ialah dewi Titan yang mempersonifikasikan ingatan dan menjadi ibu sembilan Muses bersama Zeus.
short_description.en: Mnemosyne is a Titan goddess personifying memory and mother of the nine Muses with Zeus.

long_description.id: Mnemosyne menguasai ingatan dan dikaitkan dengan bahasa, kata, serta pewarisan kisah sebelum tulisan dikenal. Sebagai putri Ouranos, ia termasuk Titan dan juga dikaitkan dengan waktu. Namanya berarti ingatan.
long_description.en: Mnemosyne governs memory and is linked to language, words and the preservation of stories before writing. As Ouranos' daughter she is a Titan also associated with time. Her name means memory.

long_description.id: Bersama Zeus, Mnemosyne menjadi ibu sembilan Muses setelah sembilan malam bersama. Para Muses menaungi seni seperti musik, tari, dan puisi. Sebuah tafsir Hesiod menempatkan kemampuan Muses menghalau kesusahan berpasangan dengan ingatan yang dilambangkan ibu mereka.
long_description.en: With Zeus, Mnemosyne mothers the nine Muses after nine nights together. The Muses patronize arts such as music, dance and poetry. One reading of Hesiod sets the Muses' relief from troubles beside the memory embodied by their mother.

long_description.id: Mnemosyne juga dikaitkan dengan orakel Trophonios di Boiotia, yang memiliki sumur suci dan takhta baginya. Sumber kuno menyebut sebuah patung Mnemosyne di Athens. Dalam satu klasifikasi ia juga dinamai sebagai salah satu Muses yang lebih tua.
long_description.en: Mnemosyne is also linked to the oracle of Trophonios in Boiotia, where she had a sacred well and throne. An ancient source mentions her statue in Athens. One classification also names her among the elder Muses.

selection_criteria: computeFillStatus must be lengkap-informasi: complete, valid research without an approved image.
No active editorial artwork and no permanent artwork exclusion.
The accepted research entry is embedded unchanged; the image may only depict what its claims document.
Creatures an earlier batch left out keep that reason as catatan_sebelumnya; the generator may decline them with status tidak-digambar.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar. A calm scene without agency fails.
user_policy.self_check: Before accepting an image the generator answers all of these with yes: the being dominates the frame; it still looks dangerous or majestic at 200 px; there is a moment, not a static pose; each visible effect points to a claim id; head, eye and limb counts match the claims; no text, watermark, border or borrowed design; it would not be rejected as ordinary person, ordinary animal, landscape only, or cute and calm. One no means regenerate, keep the rejected attempt as history, up to three attempts.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly cinematic illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Every design is original and sourced from the accepted research.
